Now, as your family evolved, you started to develop more complex ways to communicate. You began to understand each other's feelings and needs. This helped you form stronger bonds and work together better.

Over time, these bonds became more important for your survival. When you worked well together, you could help each other find food, protect your homes, and even care for babies. So, you started to feel more connected to each other, and that feeling is what we call love.

So, in a way, love is a way for mammals to be friends and work together as a family.
